\LF. WATERTIGHT CONSTRUCTION:
\l1.	THE FOLLOWING STRUCTURAL ELEMENTS ARE TO BE CONSTRUCTED IN ACCORDANCE WITH SPECIFICATIONS
A.	INSITU PLANTERS\PB.	LANDSCAPE AREAS
2.	WATER TANK SLAB AND WALLS SHALL BE COATED WITH A CEMENTITIOUS FLEXIBLE COATING. THE MATERIAL SHALL BE NON-TOXIC AND NON-HAZARDOUS.
3.	WATER BARS AND SEALANTS SHALL BE FROM SERVICISED LTD OR EQUAL APPROVED\L
G. MANHOLES, SUMPS AND WATER TANKS.
\l1.	THE LATEST DM STANDARD SPECIFICATIONS FOR GRP LINING SHALL BE APPLIED TO THE FOLLOWING:
A.	ALL INTERNAL SURFACES OF SEWERAGE MANHOLES AND HOUSE CONNECTION CHAMBERS. \PB.	FOULWATER / STORMWATER SUMPS BENCHING.\PC.	WATER TANKS  (EXCEPT DRINKING WATER TANKS, CEMENTITIOUS FLEXIBLE COATING SHALL BE USED).
2.	FOR MATERIAL REQUIREMENTS REFER TO ARCHITECTURAL SPECIFICATIONS.
\L
\l
\LH. BLOCKWORK
\l1.	BLOCKWORK (ALL LIGHT WEIGHT, DRY WALL PARTITIONS AND HOLLOW BLOCKS SHALL COMPLY WITH THE 	REQUIREMENTS OF THE LOCAL MUNICIPALITY.)
A.	ALL  SUPERSTRUCTURE PARTITIONS SHALL BE LIGHT WEIGHT PARTITIONS WITH UNIT WEIGHT NOT MORE THAN 6.00 KN/M AS PER ARCHITECTURAL DRAWINGS.\PB.	 ALL LIGHT WEIGHT BLOCK WORKS SHALL BE NON LOAD BEARING.  BLOCK WORKS FOR LOAD BEARING WALLS SHALL BE IN SOLID BLOCKS.\PC.	JOINTS BETWEEN NON LOAD BEARING BLOCK WORK AND SUSPENDED SLABS OR BEAMS TO HAVE 25mm\PD.	COMPRESSIBLE JOINT FILLER.  \PE.	 QUALITY OF CONCRETE BLOCKS SHALL BE AS FOLLOWS:
		MINIMUM CRUSHING STRENGTH AT 28 DAYS WORKING TEST:
i.	LOAD BEARING BLOCKS		> 12.5 N/mm² FOR AVERAGE OF 10 BLOCKS
								> 10.0 N/mm²  FOR ANY BLOCKS
ii.	NON LOAD BEARING BLOCKS  	> 7.5 N/mm²  FOR AVERAGE OF 10 BLOCKS
								> 7.5 N/mm²   FOR ANY BLOCKS
F.	 ALL THE BLOCK WORK ALONG WITH SECONDARY FRAMING ELEMENTS SHALL BE DESIGNED BY CONTRACTOR AND SUBMITTED TO ENGINEERS FOR APPROVAL.\PG.	ALL BLOCK WORK BELOW GROUND SHALL BE CONSTRUCTED FROM SULPHATE RESISTING CEMENT.  \PH.	DENSITY FOR  NORMAL CONCRTE FOR BLOCKS SHOULD NOT BE LESS THAN 1320 Kg/m³
2.	MORTAR DESIGNATION (iii) TO BS 5628 : PT. 1 : 1992
3.	PROTECTIVE COATING (BELOW GROUND) UNO TWO COATS APPROVED BITUMINOUS PAINT. REFER TO SPECIFICATION REQUIREMENTS.
\LI. DEFERRED SUBMITTAL
1.	THE FOLLOWING ITEMS SHALL BE CONSIDERED AS DEFERRED SUBMITTAL AND SHALL BE DESIGNED BY THE CONTRACTOR. THE GENERAL CONTRACTOR SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR PROVIDING ENGINEERED SHOP DRAWINGS FROM THE SPECIALTY SUBCONTRACTOR PREPARED UNDER THE DIRECT SUPERVISION OF A CALIFORNIA LICENSED ENGINEER. THESE SHOP DRAWINGS SHALL BE PROVIDED TO THE ARCHITECT, ENGINEER, AND BUILDING DEPARTMENT OF AUTHORITY OF JURISDICTION FOR REVIEW AND APPROVAL PRIOR TO FABRICATION. THESE ITEMS SHALL INCLUDE:
A.	SHORING SYSTEMS\PB.	STEEL STRUCTURE CONNECTIONS\PC.	STEEL STRUCTURE MICS. SUCH AS CANOPIES, TRELLIS, SECONDARY STEEL FOR FACED SUPPORTS, STEEL STAIRS, MASTS AND ROOF TOPS\PD.	CURTAIN WALL SYSTEMS\PE.	ALL TEMPORARY WORKS AND ERECTION SEQUENCES REQUIRED TO COMPLETE THE WORKS\PF.	FRAMING AND SUPPORTING STRUCTURE TO ALL ACCESS DOORS AND OPENINGS INCLUDING ROLLER SHUTTERS AND LOADING BAYS, ETC.\PG.	BLOCK WORK DETAILS
\LJ. CODE
\l
1.	BUILDING SHALL COMPLY WITH THE 2022 INTERNATIONAL BUILDING CODE & 2021 DUBAI CODE. SYMBOLS AND DEFINITIONS ARE PER LATEST EDITION OF ASCE7
2.	RISK CATEGORY: II
3.	VERTICAL LIVE LOADS FOR EACH USE PER ASCE7 AND DUBAI BUILDING CODE
A.	ROOF  Lr = 2.0 kN/m (REDUCIBLE)\PB.	FLOORS L = RESIDENTIAL & LIVING SPACES = 2.0 kN/m\PC.	EGRESS L = 4.8 kN/m (NON-REDUCIBLE)\PD.	PARKING = 2.0 kN/m
4.	WIND:
B.	V (MRI10):				30 m/sec\PC.	V (MRI700):				47 m/sec\PD.	WIND IMPORTANCE, I:		1.00\PE.	EXPOSURE TYPE: 			C\PF.	OCCUPANCY CATEGORY: 		II
G.	DIRECTIONAL FACTOR, Kd: 		1.0
H.	ENCLOSURE CLASSIFICATION: 	CLOSED
INTERSTORY DRIFT: EXPECTED INTERSTORY DRIFT FOR EACH STORY IS AS OUTLINED BELOW. ALL NON-STRUCTURAL ELEMENTS OF THE BUILDING INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO FINISHES, GLAZING, MEP, ETC. SHALL TAKE INTO ACCOUNT THIS PARAMETER.
INELASTIC INTERSTORY DRIFT LIMIT = H/400 TO H/600\POVER DISPLACEMENT LIMIT = H/500
5.	SEISMIC:
A.	SITE CLASS: D
B.	SEISMIC DESIGN CATEGORY: II
C.	SEISMIC IMPORTANCE FACTOR, Ie: 1.0
D.	S = 0.51\PE.	S = 0.18
F.	F = 1.392
G.	F = 2.24
H.	S = 0.4733	  \PI.	S = 0.2688\PJ.	R = 4.0 - BUILDING FRAME SYSTEM ORDINARY REINFORCEMENT SHEAR WALLS
K.	ρ =  1.0
\PINTERSTORY DRIFT: EXPECTED INTERSTORY DRIFT FOR EACH STORY IS AS OUTLINED BELOW. ALL NON-STRUCTURAL ELEMENTS OF THE BUILDING INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO FINISHES, GLAZING, MEP, ETC. SHALL TAKE INTO ACCOUNT THIS PARAMETER.
-	INELASTIC INTERSTORY DRIFT RATIO = 0.02
-	ELASTIC INTERSTORY DRIFT RATIO = CONTACT CONSULTANT
\LK. FIRE RESISTANCE REQUIREMENTS
\l1.	THE GENERAL REQUIREMENT FOR THE STRUCTURE ARE AS PER THE FOLLOWING UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE  IN THE FIRE & SAFTEY REPORT BY THE SPECIALIST.
A.	LOAD BEARING WALLS, COLUMNS, AND TRANSFER BEAMS 			2hrs\PB.	FLOOR CONSTRUCTION INCLUDING BEAMS 					2hrs\PC.	SHAFTS AND STAIR WALLS 							2hrs\PD.	ROOF CEILING, ASSEMBLIES > 6.10M FROM FLOOR				0hr\PE.	ROOF CEILING, ASSEMBLIES =< 6.10M FROM FLOOR)				2hrs
\LL. LIGHTNING PROTECTION
\l1.	THE CONCRETE FRAME FORMS PART OF THE LIGHTING PROTECTION SYSTEM. FOR DESIGNATED LIGHTNING PROTECTION COLUMNS, THE CONTRACTOR MUST ENSURE THAT THE FOLLOWING MEASURES ARE CARRIED OUT:
F.	GOOD CONTACT BETWEEN REINFORCING BARS SHOULD BE ENSURED, i.e. BY FIXING THE BARS  WITH TYING WIRE. REFER TO ELECTRICAL DRAWINGS FOR ELECTRICAL TYING WIRE SIZE.  \PG.	 	TIES SHOULD BE PROVIDED FOR BOTH VERTICAL LAPS IN MAIN REINFORCEMENT AND BETWEEN LINKS AND MAIN REINFORCEMENT.\PH.	REFER TO ELECTRICAL DRAWINGS FOR LOCATION OF DESIGNATION OF LIGHTING PROTECTION  ELEMENTS AND SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS.
2.	FOR DETAILS AND LOCATION OF EARTHING PITS REFER TO RELEVANT SERVICE DRAWINGS.
\L\PM. ABBREVIATIONS
\l\PACRONYMS OF ABBREVIATION MAY INTERCHANGEABLY USED WITH OR WITHOUT SEPARATION DOTS (E.G. BOTH AB OR A.B. MEAN "ANCHOR BOLTS")
